title: Raytracer: blurred (glossy) reflections with a parameter per material and a switch
author: Claude-JG
description: Reflections are mirror-sharp. A material shall get a roughness (0 = sharp, the default) by which the reflected ray is spread over a cone, sampled with a number of reflection rays (a raytracer setting; 1 or roughness 0 keeps the sharp reflection and its cost), with the stratified samples and the adaptive refinement of the soft shadows.
releaseNotes: In the raytracer, a material with roughness > 0 gets blurred reflections: raytracer.reflectionSamples rays per pixel (default 8) spread over a cone of the angular radius roughness; roughness 0 (the default) or reflectionSamples = 1 gives sharp reflections. The cost of the reflections grows with the number of rays.
